candidateInputs.conditions: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio original pay-as-you-go API list price; Singapore deployment, International scope, 0 < request input tokens <= 256000. Input and output tokens are charged at the same listed rates in thinking and non-thinking modes. Context caching and batch inference are unsupported. The model also accepts image and video input, which requires separate real-channel metering review before any public usage billing. Promotional offers and free quota do not change the regular user-price baseline.
candidateInputs.evidence: 2026-10-10 exact model page: Singapore International original API prices are input 0.375 and output 2.25 USD per 1M tokens; the page marks context caching and batch inference unsupported. The input/output rates independently match the 2026-10-09 Alibaba comparison. China and Global prices are separate official scopes and are not selected here.
